About the Fellowship

2-year tax-free postdoctoral scholarship in Philosophy at Umeå University. Research on causation and cognitive value. 720,000 SEK total. Starts 1 Jan 2027. Apply by 7 Oct 2026.

OpportunityPostdoc Scholarship in Philosophy at Umeå University
HostUmeå University
LocationUmeå, Sweden
Study LevelPostdoctoral
FundingFully Funded
StipendSEK 720,000/month (tax-free)
Application Deadline7 October 2026
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Funding detail: SEK 720,000 total for 2 years (tax-free, approximately 30,000 SEK/month).

Project Description

The Department of Historical, Philosophical and Religious Studies at Umeå University offers a postdoctoral scholarship in philosophy for research on the project 'Why is causation so useful?'. The scholarship is full-time for two years, starting 1 January 2027 or by agreement. Open to candidates with background in metaphysics, philosophy of science, or related fields.

The project investigates what makes causal understanding so cognitively valuable in science and everyday life, and how causal reasoning can be both objectively reliable and yet bear the imprint of human cognitive constraints. Research questions address how causal reasoning can be both anchored in the structure of the world and shaped by our cognitive constitution.

Financial Coverage

  • Tax-free scholarship funded by the Kempe Foundations.
  • Amount: 720,000 SEK total (approximately 30,000 SEK per month).
  • Paid in four separate installments during the scholarship period.

Research Environment

The philosophy unit has 18 tenured faculty members with high research activity including weekly research seminars, guest lectures, reading groups, and a yearly named lecture series. Previous philosophy postdocs have gone on to positions at Stanford, Syracuse, Auburn, Birmingham, Reading, and Erlangen-Nürnberg. Research interests span metaphysics, philosophy of science, epistemology, philosophy of mind, ethics, political philosophy, AI philosophy, and more.

Eligibility and Requirements

  • Doctoral degree in philosophy or equivalent foreign degree, completed no later than decision date.
  • Normally completed within three years before application deadline. Special reasons (illness, parental leave, military service, etc.) may extend.
  • Proficiency in written and spoken English required.
  • Must work in Umeå and participate regularly in department seminars and activities.

Assessment Criteria

  • Primary weight: ability to conduct and publish research of highest international quality.
  • Alignment of research plan with project aims.
  • Fit of candidate's background with existing research environment.

Application

Submit via Varbi by 7 October 2026. Documents in English or Swedish, Word or PDF:

  • Cover letter describing research experience and motivation.
  • CV including publication list.
  • Research plan related to the project topic (applicants encouraged to think broadly).
  • Certified copy of doctoral degree certificate or documentation of expected completion.
  • Contact information for two references.

Contacts

Bram Vaassen, bram.vaassen@umu.se; Christian Löw, +46-90-7866936

Official Link

https://www.umu.se/en/work-with-us/postdoctoral-scholarships/postdoctoral-scholarship-2-years-in-philosophy-_929916/

Important Notes

  • Always confirm the full requirements and current deadline on the official website before applying.
  • Prepare the requested documents early — competitive awards are often decided on complete, on-time submissions.
  • Funding terms shown here reflect the listing at the time of publication and can be updated by the provider.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 7 October 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
